sentences.text: The present application has been filed by the appellant seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

2. By way of present appeal, the appellant seeks to assail the judgement of conviction dated 25.11.2021 and order on sentence dated 22.01.2022 vide which he has been directed to undergo RI for a period of 14 years with payment of fine of Rs.1,000/- for the offence punishable under Section 376 IPC and in case of default of fine to further undergo SI for 15 days; he is further sentenced to RI for 2.5 years with fine of Rs.500/- for the offence punishable under Section 354D IPC and in default of payment of fine to further undergo SI for 7 days.
The benefit of Section 428 Cr.P.C. has also been provided to the appellant.

5. I have heard the learned counsels for the parties and also gone through the testimony of the child victim as well as MLC and Medical Status Report.
6. On the directions of this Court, a Medical Status Report dated 20.03.2025 under the signatures of Sr. Medical Officer, Central Jail No. 14, Mandoli, Delhi has been received.

Relevant extract of the said Medical Status Report are as under :-
"1. Inmate is a known case of Seizure disorder, fatty liver, DM 2 (controlled on medication) and swelling in both upper and lower limb and abdominal distention.
2. Inmate is under treatment from G.B. Pant, department of neurology and department of gastroenterology, IHBAS, Safdarjang Hospital and GTBH/Ortho dept.

Keeping in view the totality of the facts and circumstances, and as per the nominal roll dated 27.03.2025, the appellant has undergone 6 years, 4 months and 7 days with remission earned 8 months and 6 days.

Accordingly, the sentence of the appellant is directed to be suspended during the pendency of appeal on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court/Duty Judicial Magistrate/Link Judicial Magistrate/Jail Superintendent and also subject to the further following conditions:-
